text_block_list.text:
Air Groove ran giving it everything she 
had. However... she was unable to achieve 
the Triple Tiara.

However, with an unforgettable run, Air 
Groove showed Mejiro Dober what the 
"ideal" truly looked like.

Air Groove is pleased to be someone Mejiro 
Dober looks up to. Bracing herself, she 
resolves to aim for even greater heights.
